name: softtwin_tactile_grasp
robot: 3-finger soft pneumatic gripper (PRBM, 4 segments per finger) on a 3-axis gantry, with a firmness plunger in the palm; simulated in MuJoCo

split.unit: episode (each episode is a new object instance with its own randomized hidden physics)

action.name: p_cmd
action.definition: absolute chamber-pressure command shared by the 3 fingers

annotation_spec.crushed: 60 ms (3-sample) moving average of the true grip force while held (grip..lower) > the object's allowable force
annotation_spec.dropped: lifted, then no finger contact (true force < 0.02 N) for 0.1 s during transport or lowering
annotation_spec.slipped: not lifted (the object stayed on the table)
annotation_spec.success: lifted, in the tray, not crushed
annotation_spec.true_class: handling class from the hidden physics (allowable force), not from appearance

probing.desc: true while the finger probe (squeeze to 0.8 N) is active

p_cmd.desc: action: chamber-pressure command shared by the 3 fingers

bend_model.desc: free bend predicted by the actuator model for the measured pressure

bend_meas.desc: bend sensor of each finger (noise 0.3 deg, 0.1 deg steps, 20 ms lag)

bend_true.desc: true total bend of each finger (sum of its 4 joint angles)

f_est.desc: grip force estimated from bend + skin location (no force sensor)

f_true.desc: true grip force: sum of normal contact forces fingers-object

skin.desc: fabric skin reading (sensor model: dead zone, noise, gain spread, crosstalk, lag, 12 bit, 8 N full scale)

skin_true.desc: true normal force on each taxel area

pregrasp_mask.desc: wrist camera: object mask (from the renderer's segmentation)

grasp_mask.desc: close camera: object mask (from the renderer's segmentation)

lift_mask.desc: close camera: object mask (from the renderer's segmentation)

plunger_features.desc: plunger features: slope k_p [N/mm], top height [m], indentation [m]

vision_features.desc: mean r, g, b, area, aspect of the object mask in the wrist image

provenance: generated by sim_mujoco/tactile_dataset.py generate --per-object 60 (seeds 1000+); simulator ground truth, no human labels
